review_scope: Collected closed six-cell study and supplemental six-reader receipts; no remote actions, benchmarks, physical payload reads, source changes or main prose edits.

auditor_failure_retained.cause: Assumed the original and regenerated integrity audit JSON bytes were identical; they differ only in recorded_utc. Final audit pins both and requires every other field exactly equal.

boundary: Measured two samples per runtime and all warmups retained; shared-host descriptive comparisons only. Whole-host postsequence counters do not establish per-cell memory-pressure deltas or runtime causality.
